parameters.content:
## 🗄️ Log: Submission Error
Saves the error text (first 500 chars) and flags for manual submission.

## 🗄️ Log: Pending
Saves the tracking ID and sets **next_check_at = now + 6 h**. The *Pending Status Poller* workflow picks it up from there.

## 🗄️ Log: Denied
Saves denial code + reason and flags for manual review (appeal letter to be sent).

## 🗄️ Log: Approved
Saves auth number, valid-from/to dates and submitted time. `is_approved = true`.

## 🗄️ Log: Eligibility Failed
Inactive coverage or payer error. Saves the result and number of polls, flags for manual review.

## 🗄️ Log: Not Submitted
Physician rejected or didn't answer in 24 h. Status `physician_rejected` / `physician_no_response` and **needs_manual_review = true** (the guide's manual review record).

## 🗄️ Log: Validation Rejected
Saves the rejected request to Supabase with the list of missing / invalid fields and flags it for manual review. No patient name is stored here.

## 🗄️ Log: Physician Approved
Records the physician's approval (actor = physician), then continues to the eligibility check.

## 🗄️ Log: Review Requested
Status → `awaiting_physician` with the review reason, just before the approval email goes out.

## 🗄️ Log: Case Created
Creates the request row: codes, payer, urgency, review decision. Patient **name + DOB are encrypted** inside Supabase (pgcrypto). Runs in line, so the row exists before anything else happens.

## ⑥ Epic – Sign JWT
Builds a signed JWT (iss/sub = client ID, aud = token URL, unique jti, 4-min expiry) with private key `kid saids-prior-auth-key-2`. This is Epic's backend-services (SMART) auth.

## ⑦ Epic – Access Token
Sends the JWT as a `client_assertion` (client_credentials grant) to Epic's token URL and gets a short-lived **Bearer access_token** used by the 4 FHIR calls.

## ① Webhook – Intake
Entry point. Receives a **POST** at `/prior-auth-request` with patient_id, encounter_id, procedure (CPT), diagnosis codes (ICD-10), payer, NPI and an optional clinical note.

## ④ Validate Fields
Gate: patient, encounter, procedure, diagnoses and payer must be present and NPI must be exactly 10 digits.
✅ true → Epic login
❌ false → rejection email

## ② Config
All settings in one place: Epic & Availity URLs, client ID, ORG_NPI, emails, `AVAILITY_PA_MODE` (mock/live).
**Phase 6:** `SUPABASE_URL` and `PENDING_POLL_HOURS` (6).

## ③ Normalize Request
Cleans the webhook body (trim, upper-case codes, diagnosis list).
**Phase 6:** also creates the `requestId` here, so the rejection log and every later step share one ID.

## ⑤ Rejection Email
Tells billing staff the request was refused and lists each field as OK / MISSING so they can fix and resubmit. Flow ends here.

## ⑧ FHIR Patient
`GET /Patient/{id}` → name, birth date, gender. Needed for the payer eligibility check and PA request.

## ⑨ FHIR Encounter
`GET /Encounter/{id}` → visit status, type and dates. Confirms the encounter exists.

## ⑩ FHIR Clinical Notes
`GET /DocumentReference?patient=…&type=11506-3` (LOINC progress note). The note text is the evidence the AI uses for medical necessity.

nodes.name: Note - Epic FHIR - Get Clinical Notes1

parameters.content:
## ⑪ FHIR Coverage
`GET /Coverage?patient=…&status=active` → member ID, group number, payer name from the patient's insurance on file.

## ⑫ Merge
Waits for all **4** parallel FHIR calls to finish before continuing, so the next step has everything at once.

## ⑬ Build Case File
Combines request + FHIR data: patient name/DOB, coverage, decoded note (falls back to the request's note), ICD-10/CPT format checks. Reuses the `requestId` from step ③.

nodes.name: Note - Code - Merge FHIR + Decode Notes1

parameters.content:
## ⑮ Parse AI Response
Safely parses the AI JSON (fallback values if it fails – never stops the flow). Sets `reviewRequired` when: no note, AI flags insufficient docs, emergent, or < 3 days. Name says Claude, but it reads OpenAI output.

## ⑯ Needs Physician Review?
Reads the flags from ⑮ (by node name, because the Supabase log now sits in between).
✅ true → log + email physician + wait
❌ false → eligibility check

## ⑭ AI Clinical Extraction
GPT-4o (temp 0, JSON mode) reads the note + codes and returns: justification, evidence, prior treatments, urgency, duration, necessity statement, **documentation gaps**. Told to use only facts in the note.

## ⑰ Physician Review Email
Sends the physician the summary, evidence and gaps with **APPROVE & SUBMIT** / **REJECT** buttons. Buttons hit this run's resume URL (`?action=approve|reject`).

## ⑱ Wait for Decision
Pauses the run until a button is clicked (webhook resume) or 24 hours pass. The click's `?action=` comes through as `query.action`.

## ⑲ Physician Approved?
`action == approve` → continue to eligibility.
Reject **or timeout** (no action = `expired`) → 'not submitted' email.

## ⑳ Not Submitted Email
Tells billing the PA was **not** sent and why (rejected or no reply in 24 h). Manual follow-up needed. Flow ends.

## ㉑ Availity Eligibility
`POST /coverages` (OAuth2) with payer, NPI, member ID, name, DOB, service type 30 (general health). Starts a real-time insurance check.

## ㉒ Evaluate Eligibility
Reads the payer reply: statusCode 4 + active plan → `active`; 4 without → `inactive`; 0 → `in_process` (retry); anything else → `error`. Gives up after 5 polls (`$runIndex`).

## ㉓ Route by Eligibility
active → build PA request
in_process → wait & poll again
inactive / error → failure email

## ㉔ Wait (poll delay)
Pauses **3 seconds** before asking Availity again for a pending eligibility result. (Unit now set explicitly to seconds.)

## ㉕ Poll Eligibility
`GET /coverages/{coverageId}` to fetch the updated result, then loops back to ㉒. Forms a retry loop (max 5).

## ㉖ Eligibility Failure Email
Insurance inactive, payer error, or no answer after 5 polls. Tells billing to verify coverage. Flow ends.

## ㉗ Build PA Request
Assembles the payer submission: provider + org NPI, patient, CPT/ICD codes, urgency code (R/U/E), necessity statement + justification. Also decides mock vs live and the mock outcome.

## ㉘ Mock or Live?
`mode == mock` → simulated payer response (safe testing)
otherwise → real Availity submission

## ㉙ Mock Payer Response
Fakes a payer reply for testing: approved (auth # + 90-day validity), denied (NMN), pending (tracking ID) or error. Pick with `mock_outcome` in the request or Config.

nodes.name: Note - Code - Mock Availity PA Response

parameters.content:
## ㉚ Submit PA (Live)
`POST /service-reviews` with the PA request. ⚠️ Placeholder – Service Reviews isn't in Availity Demo; confirm URL & payload in Availity Service Reviews docs before going live.

## ㉛ Normalize PA Response
Maps any payer format (mock or live) to one status: approved / denied / pending / error, plus auth #, tracking ID, denial reason/code, validity dates.

## ㉜ Route by Outcome
approved → care-team email
denied → AI appeal letter
pending → billing email
error → submission-error email

## ㉝ Approved Email
Tells the care team the auth #, validity dates, patient and procedure. Subject gets `[TEST]` in mock mode.

## ㉞ AI Appeal Letter
GPT-4o drafts an appeal addressing the denial reason using only the case facts; placeholders like [Physician Name] for missing details.

## ㉟ Denied + Appeal Email
Sends the physician the denial reason and the draft appeal letter to review before sending to the payer.

## ㊱ Pending Email
Tells billing the payer pended the request + tracking ID, and that the status is re-checked automatically every 6 hours.

## ㊲ Submission Error Email
Payer call failed. Shows the error and asks billing to submit manually in Availity.

# Prior Authorization Automation
**Goal:** take a PA request from the EHR side, pull the patient's chart from **Epic FHIR**, let **GPT-4o** write the medical-necessity justification, get a **physician sign-off** when needed, check **insurance eligibility** and submit the PA via **Availity**, then email the right person with the result (and an AI appeal letter if denied).

**Phase 6 (this version):** every outcome is written to Supabase (`log_prior_auth`), with patient name/DOB encrypted. Anything a person must act on gets `needs_manual_review = true`. Pending requests are re-checked by the separate *Prior Auth – Pending Status Poller* workflow. 🗄️ = Supabase log node (they never stop the workflow if Supabase is down).

**Colour key**
🟨 Intake & validation · 🟦 Epic FHIR data · 🟪 AI steps · 🟧 Human review / pending · 🟩 Availity eligibility & submission · ⬜ Config / mock · 🟥 Stop / failure emails

**Before go-live:** set ORG_NPI & real emails in Config, switch AVAILITY_PA_MODE to `live` only after confirming the Service Reviews endpoint, and make sure a HIPAA BAA covers sending PHI to OpenAI.

Also return documentation_gaps[] listing what a payer would expect that the note does not contain, and insufficient_documentation (boolean). If the clinical note is missing, return empty evidence arrays, set insufficient_documentation to true, and say so in clinical_justification." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Clinical Note:
' + ($json.clinicalNote || '[No clinical note found]') + '

Requested Procedure CPT: ' + $json.procedure_code + '
Diagnosis Codes (ICD-10): ' + JSON.stringify($json.diagnosis_codes) + '

Return the prior authorization justification JSON.' } ] }) }}
